global_rules.trigger: TRIGGERED requires preserved evidence satisfying every required condition for the detector.
global_rules.abstain: EVALUATION_ABSTAINED when a required condition or evidentiary bridge cannot be established from the evaluated package.
global_rules.scoped_non_trigger: CRITERIA_NOT_SATISFIED_IN_EVALUATED_SCOPE means only that trigger criteria were not established in the evaluated selection; it is not global absence.
global_rules.mapping_separation: Detector evaluation consumes explicit mapping records; missing/failed mapping cannot be converted into a valid non-trigger.
global_rules.historical_nonretroactivity: Later detector criteria do not become historical requirements of earlier artifacts.

detectors.name: SPEC_TO_EXECUTION_EQUIVALENCE
required_conditions: A source-native declared/specification state D and execution/runtime state X are distinguishable for the evaluated proposition.
The evaluated representation asserts or operationally treats D as sufficient to establish X without direct execution evidence.
detectors.trigger_rule: Trigger only when both distinguishability and D->X promotion are preserved.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain when D/X basis is under-specified or execution evidence provenance cannot be resolved.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when the evaluated representation explicitly preserves D and X as separate or no D->X promotion is observed in inspected scope.

detectors.name: SURFACE_BOOLEAN_COLLAPSE
required_conditions: The ontology in scope contains at least one non-binary surface state relevant to the same boundary.
A downstream surface-evaluation field for that boundary is restricted to boolean satisfaction without a separately bound state field carrying the lost distinction.
detectors.trigger_rule: Trigger on representational compression from the relevant non-binary surface state space to boolean at the evaluated seam.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain if the supposedly lost state is demonstrably preserved in another bound field but its relation to the boolean cannot be established.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when the evaluated schema retains the relevant non-binary state explicitly at the same decision seam.

detectors.name: UNCERTAINTY_PROMOTED_TO_VIOLATED
required_conditions: A concrete uncertain state such as UNDETERMINED or UNMEASURABLE is preserved.
A mapping or control-flow step converts that state to a value consumed as dissatisfaction/false.
The downstream rule resolves that value to VIOLATED.
detectors.trigger_rule: Trigger only on an evidenced uncertainty->intermediate->VIOLATED path.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain when the architecture permits the path but the uncertainty-to-intermediate mapping is not preserved.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when uncertainty is preserved as uncertainty and cannot reach VIOLATED without additional positive violation evidence.

detectors.name: TUPLE_SET_OPERATOR_WITHOUT_DECLARED_SEMANTICS
required_conditions: A structured proposition/role vector is the operand.
Set operators such as subset, intersection, or empty-set comparison are applied.
No set denotation or boundary-scoped partial-order/operator semantics are declared before use.
detectors.trigger_rule: Trigger when all three conditions are present.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain if operator semantics may exist outside the inspected package and the package does not establish their absence.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when the operator semantics are explicitly declared for the structured operands before evaluation.

detectors.name: RETROACTIVE_NATIVE_IDENTITY
required_conditions: A retrospective reconstruction/measurement of historical semantics is identified.
The reconstruction is labeled, substituted, or operationally consumed as the contemporaneous native historical state without a non-retroactivity boundary.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain if the provenance/time basis of the asserted native state is unresolved.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when historical native state and later retrospective analysis remain separately identified.

detectors.name: IMPLEMENTATION_PROMOTED_TO_EXECUTION
required_conditions: Implementation/presence state and execution state are distinguishable.
Implementation/presence is used as sufficient evidence for execution.
detectors.trigger_rule: Trigger on implementation/presence->executed promotion without execution evidence.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain if implementation or execution evidence cannot be independently resolved.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when implementation/presence and execution remain distinct.

detectors.name: NON_VIOLATION_PROMOTED_TO_CONSERVATION
required_conditions: The evaluated state establishes only absence of a detected/verified violation or an unresolved/non-violating state.
That state is promoted to affirmative conservation/preservation without the positive evidence required by the conservation rule.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain when the positive conservation evidence basis is unavailable.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when preservation requires its own positive evidence and weaker states remain weaker.

detectors.name: CONCEPT_SCHEMA_STATE_MISMATCH
required_conditions: The governing concept/ontology defines one or more states relevant to the evaluated boundary.
The concrete schema used at that boundary cannot represent one or more of those states or maps them to a different standing without an explicit compatibility rule.
detectors.trigger_rule: Trigger on evidenced concept/schema representational mismatch.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain when the allegedly missing state may be represented elsewhere but the binding cannot be resolved.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when the schema can represent the governing state space or an explicit compatibility mapping is preserved.

detectors.name: ANALYTICAL_IDENTIFIER_COLLISION
required_conditions: One identifier/token is used for two distinct objects or state roles such as historical artifact and retrospective reconstruction.
The collision permits identity/standing to pass between those objects without a separately preserved relation.
detectors.trigger_rule: Trigger when both collision and standing ambiguity/promotion are preserved.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain if reuse is visible but the identity/standing consequence is unresolved.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when identifiers are role-distinct or explicit relation typing prevents identity collapse.

detectors.name: EXECUTION_ONLY_EQUIVALENCE
required_conditions: Boundary equivalence/conservation has multiple required dimensions.
Equivalence is concluded from execution-transition compatibility alone while another required dimension is absent, conflicting, or unmeasured.
detectors.trigger_rule: Trigger on execution-only evidence being promoted to full boundary equivalence.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain when required equivalence dimensions are not defined for the evaluated boundary.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when full equivalence requires all declared dimensions or the claim is explicitly narrowed to execution-only equivalence.

detectors.name: EXAMPLE_RECEIPT_PROMOTION
required_conditions: A hash, offset, receipt, or binding value is presented in an empirical evidence field.
The value was illustrative, placeholder, prefilled, or not computed from the bound artifact bytes.
The record does not explicitly mark the value as illustrative/not executed.
detectors.trigger_rule: Trigger when illustrative/placeholder evidence is presented with empirical binding standing.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain when computation provenance cannot be determined.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when empirical values are recomputed from exact bytes or synthetic values are explicitly marked illustrative/not executed.

detectors.name: TARGET_CONDITIONED_EXTRACTION
required_conditions: Stage 1 selection/extraction uses downstream semantic target criteria, detector identity, expected finding class, or equivalent information to filter candidates.
That conditioning is not separately represented as candidate selection provenance, or the resulting extraction is presented as unconditioned discovery.
detectors.trigger_rule: Trigger on hidden target conditioning or promotion of conditioned extraction to unconditioned discovery.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain when selection provenance or analyst exposure is unavailable.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when conditioning is explicitly recorded and no claim of unconditioned/blind extraction is made. Declared conditioning does not create epistemic independence.

detectors.name: NOT_ESTABLISHED_COLLAPSED_TO_FALSE
required_conditions: The source/mapping/adjudication state is NOT_ESTABLISHED, UNRESOLVED, or not performed.
A downstream boolean false or equivalent negative factual state replaces that unresolved state.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain when downstream encoding cannot be inspected.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when unresolved states remain unresolved/abstained and are not converted into false.

detectors.name: NON_TRIGGER_PROMOTED_TO_ABSENCE
required_conditions: A detector returns non-trigger/criteria-not-satisfied for a bounded evaluated selection.
A downstream statement promotes that result to global absence of the pattern beyond the evaluated scope.
detectors.trigger_rule: Trigger on scoped non-trigger->global absence promotion.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain when scope propagation cannot be inspected.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when the result remains explicitly bound to evaluated selection/scope.

detectors.name: MAPPING_DETECTION_COLLAPSE
required_conditions: Ontology mapping and detector evaluation are distinct logical operations.

A mapping failure/unresolved mapping is consumed as a valid detector non-trigger, or mapping and detection are represented as one indivisible operation such that their standing cannot be independently inspected.
detectors.trigger_rule: Trigger on unresolved/failed mapping->valid non-trigger or on an indivisible representation that prevents standing separation at the detector decision seam.
detectors.abstain_rule: Abstain when mapping provenance is missing or cannot be linked to detector inputs.
detectors.scoped_non_trigger_rule: Use scoped non-trigger when mapping and detection are separately represented, detector inputs bind to mapping records, and mapping failure routes to abstention/not-evaluated rather than non-trigger. Procedural separation alone does not establish epistemic independence.
